title: Ray and end spaces: characterizations and classification up to homeomorphism
summary: We provide a combinatorial characterization for pairs of order-theoretic trees with homeomorphic ray spaces, answering an open problem proposed by Kurkofka ad Pitz. This solution is inspired by the introduction of a transfinite topological game, which allows us to characterize not only ray spaces through the existence of winning strategies for one of the players, but also their homeomorphic classes.
